name: Scala
criteria: Scala 3 on the JVM: case classes/enums with exhaustive pattern matching, immutable and mutable collections side by side (groupMapReduce, sliding, LazyList, PriorityQueue), BigInt; strong for parsing into ADTs, interpreters and graph search.
build: mkdir -p .build && { [ -e .build/ok ] && grep -qF "$PWD/" .build/cp && [ -z "$(find . -maxdepth 1 -name '*.scala' -newer .build/ok)" ] || { touch .build/new && scala-cli compile --print-class-path . > .build/cp && mv .build/new .build/ok; }; }
